name: libgda
license_evidence: COPYING.LIB in the pinned release tarball (GNU Library General Public License version 2 text); COPYING states the library is LGPL and only the executable tools are GPL. Source files carry the 'version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version' notice.
input_api: gda_sql_parser_parse_string(GdaSqlParser*, local NUL-terminated SQL text, &remain, &error) -> GdaStatement ("structure": GdaSqlStatement tree)
scope: SQL statements from local bytes parsed one by one with the generic GdaSqlParser; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary read from the GdaSqlStatement tree. Provider-specific parsers, GdaSqlBuilder, rendering and execution are untested.
family_note: gda_sql_parser_parse_string runs GdaSqlParser's own tokenizer (gda-sql-parser.c) and the Lemon parser generated from libgda/sql-parser/parser.y, which builds the public GdaSqlStatement structs (GdaSqlStatementSelect fields, from targets and joins, where_cond, group_by, order_by; GdaSqlStatementInsert table, fields_list, values_list). The adapter prints that tree with the documented gda_sql_statement_serialize and reads it; libgda keeps literal values as SQL text, so a string literal is unquoted by the adapter. The grammar is libgda's own (Lemon is SQLite's parser generator, but parser.y is not SQLite's parse.y). No connection or provider is opened.

popularity.metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations, source package libgda5
popularity.limitation: Counts installs of the whole GNOME Data Access library (data models, providers, meta store), not use of its SQL parser; packaged installs only.

name: libpg_query
license_evidence: LICENSE in the pinned release-tag archive (BSD 3-clause text); bundled PostgreSQL sources under the PostgreSQL License
input_api: pg_query_parse(local NUL-terminated SQL text) -> PgQueryParseResult (JSON parse tree)
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary read from the library's JSON parse tree. PL/pgSQL, deparse, fingerprint and protobuf outputs are untested.
family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
family_note: pg_query_parse runs the extracted PostgreSQL raw parser (bison gram.c, flex scan.c, parser.c) and serializes the raw parse tree as JSON (pg_query_outfuncs_json.c). The adapter reads SelectStmt, InsertStmt, RangeVar, JoinExpr, FuncCall and A_Const nodes from that tree. Shared family: Go pg_query_go, Rust pg_query, Python pglast and the libpg-query/@pgsql WASM npm packages bind this library; DuckDB 1.x used a libpg_query-derived fork; DuckDB 2.0.0 (C++ cell) has its own PEG grammar.

popularity.metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations, source package libpg-query
popularity.limitation: Very small count; packaged installs only, not use through bindings or vendored copies.
